name: Paradigm of Sloth
description:
You can lumber, moving 10% slower and gaining slow, massive attacks, but lumbering replaces sprinting.

You can perform massive attacks after sprinting for 1.5 seconds. They have -66% total attack speed but strike on any swing in a 5-block radius, applying 2.5x damage and a brief stun then 1 second of -20% speed.
